label: AI Insight UI — Dispatcher
info:
Root dispatcher per FAP General Guideline §10.

Every inbound message from the SPA flows: uibuilder in → fn_normalize → fn_validate → switch by msg._req.action → responsibility subflow link-out. Every outbound result flows: link-from-response → fn_build_response (wraps FAP §9 envelope) → merge-session-send → uibuilder.

Legacy topic-based routing (msg.data.topic) is supported as a transition path during Phase 3 — legacy messages bypass the FAP envelope wrapping and pass through merge-session-send unchanged. After Phase 3.4 the legacy path is removed.

FAP Guideline reference: §10 (root dispatcher + responsibility subflows), §11 (one-handler reducer), §9 (envelopes).

name: normalize
validate
switch by action
build FAP §9 result envelope
Merge Session & Send to Client
